question: Which nature reserve are available within 100 kilometers on the south side of Hendry Regional Convenient Care Center, LaBelle, FL?
sql:
WITH origin AS  (SELECT ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-81.438769 26.755149)',4326)::geography AS geometry)
SELECT * FROM pois, origin
WHERE ST_DWithin(pois.geometry, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-81.438769 26.755149)',4326)::geography, 100000)
AND leisure = 'nature_reserve'
AND degrees(ST_Azimuth(origin.geometry, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN 157.5 AND 202.5;

answers.poi_name: Rookery Bay National Estuarine Research Reserve

[3].display_name: Hendry Regional Convenient Care Center, LaBelle, FL
